function.name: MAP_GET_PIXEL
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
function.abstract: It reads the value of a pixel of a graph

description.p: This function recovers the colour of a determined pixel inside of a graph. The coordinates increase towards down and right, and the point (0, 0) represents the top left corner of the graph.

In the case of graphs of 256 colours (8 bits), the value returned by this function is a color of 0 to 255. In oppositive case the value returned is a codification of the components of the colour that depends of the video card and graph mode. It can be used to obtain the approximated values of the components of the colour.

function.note: although GET_RGB returns value of 0 to 255 for each component of colour, it is important to understand that the precision of a mode of 16 bits is not sufficient to get all possibilities. Because the high value (255) can not be showed without 8 bits. It is not recommended the use of MAP_GET_PIXEL to use collision maps or of other type, with graphs of 16 bits. For that use is recommended to use arrays.
